decisions.question: Which one holds?
decisions.reason: These rules say different things about the same word. Choose one, and the others are set aside.
decisions.label: utilise

options.consequence: If you keep "employ": "utilise" becomes a finding in 1 block. Applies to docs.
If you keep "use": "utilise" becomes a finding in 1 block. Applies to docs.

decisions.question: Which one do your files use?
decisions.sentence: Write Sign in, not Sign In, Sign-in, Signin or SignIn.
decisions.label: Sign in

options.consequence: If you keep "Sign in": the other 4 forms become findings in 2 blocks. Applies to docs.
If you keep "Sign In": the other 4 forms become findings in 2 blocks. Applies to docs.
If you keep "Sign-in": the other 4 forms become findings in 4 blocks. Applies to docs.
If you keep "Signin": the other 4 forms become findings in 4 blocks. Applies to docs.
If you keep "SignIn": the other 4 forms become findings in 4 blocks. Applies to docs.
